name: Test: GraphicsDevice primitives and BasicEffect (C#)
author: test
summary: DrawUserPrimitives, DrawUserIndexedPrimitives, vertex and index buffers, BasicEffect and a mod .fxc effect with a world-view-projection matrix, drawn as color cells.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh cstprim. Effects/Trail.fxc comes from src/Trail.fx (fxc /T fx_2_0). Logs 'cstprim <case>: ok | FAIL', 'cstprim perf ...', 'cstprim cell <name> x,y r,g,b' and 'cstprim END pass=N fail=M'; tools/tests/cstprim/screen.py checks the cells in a screenshot.
